evidence.reason: Line 49 writes the live watchdog state with Path.write_text, which truncates before writing; a process interruption can leave partial JSON. Line 30 then unconditionally json.loads that file, so later watchdog runs crash before they can alert, defeating the watchdog. This is an ordinary reliability/correctness defect; atomic temp-file replacement plus explicit malformed-state handling fixes it. The same issue applies to the write at line 35.
